facts.fact: The national AI strategy validated on 21-22 April 2026 with UNDP provides for creating a National AI Commission (CNIA) and a Strategic Intelligence Centre under its governance axis, which also covers ethics and compliance.
facts.system: Commission Nationale de l'Intelligence Artificielle (CNIA), planned

BDI.note: The commission is planned only; no rule in force or designated authority is stated.
No government AI system is stated.
Agriculture, health and education are named only as priority sectors of the strategy, with no tool piloted or in service.

facts.fact: Digital Business Africa, citing UNDP Burundi, reports the national AI strategy was validated on 21-22 April 2026 by UNDP and Finance, Budget and Digital Economy Ministry representatives over two days of discussion; no cabinet approval or launch is stated.

BDI.note: The strategy plans a CNIA and a CIS; neither is stated as set up.
No model, dataset or AI computing is named.
Only generic data management and connectivity aims; no plan on government data control is stated.
